name: Visual Translate by Vozo
tagline: Localize video text overlays into any language without rebuilding your visuals.
problem: Businesses expanding into new markets must recreate video graphics and text overlays for each language, which is time-consuming and expensive. Visual Translate automates the detection and translation of on-screen text while preserving the original design and visual context. This removes the bottleneck of manual redesign when localizing video content at scale.
useCases: Localizing product demo videos for international markets
Translating training and onboarding videos for global teams
Adapting marketing video campaigns for multilingual audiences
Converting subtitle overlays and lower-thirds for foreign-language distribution
